name: VigilDesk
tagline: The operating system for the modern funeral home.
positioning: VigilDesk gives owner-operated funeral homes one place to run arrangements, filings, and family follow-up — without another binder or spreadsheet.

hero.h1: Every case handled. Nothing slips through.
hero.sub: VigilDesk runs the whole arrangement — intake, GPL pricing, death certificate filing, and family follow-up — so your team spends time with families, not paperwork.

features.title: Arrangement rooms
features.description: Guide each family through selections, sign the SFGS at the table, and generate the itemized statement the moment the conference ends.

features.title: Funeral Rule compliance
features.description: Your General Price List, itemized authorizations, and mandatory disclosures stay current and auditable — no more outdated PDFs in a drawer.

features.title: Certificate & permit tracking
features.description: File death certificates and burial-transit permits with a live status board, so you always know what the county has and hasn't returned.

features.title: Obituaries & memorial pages
features.description: Draft the obituary, publish a memorial page, and collect condolences and RSVPs — all linked back to the case record.

features.title: Scheduling & staff calendar
features.description: Coordinate visitations, services, removals, and crematory windows across your directors without double-booking the prep room.

features.title: Statements & at-need billing
features.description: Send families a clear invoice, apply insurance assignments, and reconcile deposits without leaving the case.

testimonials.quote: We used to rebuild the price list every time the FTC guidance changed. Now VigilDesk keeps our GPL clean and every authorization is signed at the table. Two directors, one system.
testimonials.name: Miriam Whitlock

testimonials.quote: The certificate board alone paid for it. I can see exactly which permits the county hasn't returned instead of calling around at 4pm on a Friday.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: Families notice the difference. The obituary and memorial page go live the same day, and every RSVP flows straight into our service schedule.
testimonials.name: Rosa Petrangeli

homepage.footerBlurb: VigilDesk is the case, compliance, and family-care platform built for independent funeral homes. Earnest software for serious work.
